plans.goal: Ignite the lamp oil and use the ore cart as a battering ram to breach the barricade
steps: Get close enough to the lamp oil barrel to use fire
Send the ore cart south to smash whoever defends the line
Exploit the chaos to break through and finish them inside

atoms.strategy: advance under heavy fire to oil position
atoms.text: I'm moving up the center through the carts — give me covering fire, Wren

atoms.strategy: ignite lamp oil for area denial
atoms.text: I'll ignite the lamp-oil barrel — it'll spread and force them back from the barricade

atoms.strategy: trigger set piece to break formation
atoms.text: Send the ore cart down the rails — let it crush whoever is standing in the way
Borin, Pip, keep the flanks clear — Rook has crossfire from the left and I need your backs
Once the cart hits and oil spreads, everyone follows me through the gap — don't hesitate

plans.goal: Overwhelm the barricade with coordinated assault: break the center while flanking
steps: Borin and I will hit the barricade head-on with shields up
Pip flanks left to cut off Rook; Maud stays back with support
Break through the line and finish them in close quarters

atoms.text: Borin, shields on the handcarts — we'll barrel through the center and damn the consequences
Pip, move left around the rocks — I want Rook worried about his back

atoms.strategy: provide ranged support to the assault
atoms.text: Wren, lay covering fire on the left flank — keep Rook from adjusting his aim
Maud, you anchor ten tiles back — readied for when we break their line
Borin and I are hitting the center — once they break, I'll shove whoever comes at us back into their own lines

atoms.strategy: seal the breach and mop up
atoms.text: Once we break through, form a line — don't let them rally or reinforce from the back

plans.goal: Divide their forces and eliminate them in detail: separate Crowe from her brutes
steps: Drive a wedge between Crowe and Grist to split their defense
Crush one group quickly while the other is cut off

atoms.text: Edda Crowe is the glue holding them together — focus attacks on her, make them scramble without orders

atoms.strategy: cut off brute support with terrain
atoms.text: I'll position by the cart and the oil barrel — block Grist from supporting Crowe if she retreats
Pip and Borin, when Grist is isolated, pin him between us — don't let him break and rally
Everyone who can see Rook, keep him suppressed — don't let him get a clean shot at Maud
Once Crowe or Grist breaks, the other's strength drains — hit them hard while they're confused
